outcome: Combine read status and a trimmed, case-insensitive security-code fragment within the returned recent notifications. Show matched/recent counts separately from the server-owned full-account unread count, preserve conditions through refresh/error, and provide reset.

verification.tdd: The new selector suite failed on its missing module and seven panel tests failed against the original UI before implementation. The version check failed against 1.0.8 before the update.
verification.staticChecks: Web typecheck, related ESLint, Prettier and diff checks passed. No local aggregate repository suite was run.
verification.build: One shared Docker Node build of web and server passed, including TypeScript and Vite. Later documentation leaves application source, dependencies and runtime configuration unchanged; this build is reused.

browser.environment: Authenticated actual local application and existing storage. The account returned zero recent notifications and zero global unread notifications. No synthetic records were written and no notification read action was performed.
passed: The actual dialog displayed the new read-status selector, security-code search, reset action, recent 0/0 counter, full-account unread count and explicit 100-record scope.
Selecting unread and entering a padded lowercase code survived a real refresh. Keyboard Enter on reset restored all statuses and an empty query; the reset control then became natively disabled.
Tab reached the security-code input with visible focus. Escape closed the dialog and returned focus to its trigger. Reopening reset the conditions.
Actionable reset and select controls computed to pointer; disabled reset computed to not-allowed. Both labels measured an 8px gap.
At a 390px responsive override, page client/scroll widths were both 390px and dialog client/scroll widths were both 388px. Controls and the empty result remained usable. The override was reset.
browser.testOnlyCoverage: Nonempty combined filtering, readAt independent of delivery status, a 100-row recent set with no unread matches but global unreadCount 145, cached error/loading labels and busy action semantics were verified with isolated deterministic tests, not the empty live account.
browser.screenshot: Actual desktop and responsive views inspected; accepted desktop screenshot retained in ignored local work without private notification contents.

verification.review: Primary-agent final diff review found no blocker. This medium-risk read-only presentation slice does not change API contracts, ownership, storage, rule evaluation, collection or notification write actions. Existing persistence and isolation evidence is reused.

localRuntime.containers: Web and server are healthy. Only application containers were recreated; existing databases and workers were preserved. Version aliases were checked against the actual running image IDs.

knownLimits: Filtering applies only to the returned most recent 100 notifications; it is not a complete history search. Empty recent matches do not imply zero global unread notifications.

Recent entries and unread count retain the existing independent server reads, not a shared frozen database snapshot. Read-all continues to affect all notifications owned by the account, regardless of filters.
The actual account had no notifications during browser acceptance; nonempty behavior is supported by deterministic test evidence only.
This accepts a P6-N07 UI slice, not the complete node or Phase 6. No production deployment or trading capability is claimed.
